partially_covered.missing: No explicit property or class for displaying specific organization attributes (e.g., contact name, legal form, etc.) beyond address and identifiers. Coverage limited to address and identifier.
Item details are modeled but lack explicit properties for item description, code, and unit of measure. Only price and quantity are present.

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are directly answerable via the ontology's classes and properties. Minor gaps exist for organization and item descriptive details.

strengths: Deep class hierarchy with clear subclassing
Comprehensive use of restrictions for key relations
weaknesses: No GCAs or equivalent class axioms for complex concepts
Disjointness is limited to a few class pairs
No explicit modeling of code lists or value sets for EDIFACT elements

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Missing domain or range for some properties (none detected here, but always a risk with large ontologies)
P7: Insufficient disjointness among AgentRole subclasses (BuyerRole, DeliveryPartyRole)
reasoner_risks: Complex chains of inverse functional properties may slow Hermit/Pellet
No forbidden datatypes detected; reasoner compatibility is high

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand Organization and Item classes to include additional descriptive properties (e.g., legalName, contactPoint, itemDescription, itemCode, unitOfMeasure) to fully answer CQ5 and CQ8.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Full coverage for organization and item information queries; improved semantic richness.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) and owl:equivalentClass for complex concepts such as 'InvoiceMessage with BuyerRole' or 'InvoiceLine with Tax'.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Better inferencing and validation of business logic.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model EDIFACT code lists and value sets for segments and elements (e.g., BGM, NAD qualifiers, item codes) using controlled vocabularies or enumerations.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improved interoperability and validation against EDIFACT standards.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add more disjointness axioms among AgentRole subclasses and other key classes.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Reduced classification ambiguity; better reasoner performance.

summary: The ontology provides strong coverage for UN/EDIFACT invoice structure and business roles, with deep hierarchies and good use of OWL 2 constructs. Minor improvements are needed for organization and item descriptive details and advanced axiomatization. Validator compatibility is high and no critical OWL 2 datatype violations are present.
